sources.snippet: NCA AI Assistant An AI-augmented web application for Non-Compartmental Analysis (NCA) of pharmacokinetic (PK) data. NCA AI Assistant lets clinical pharmacologists and PK scientists load concentration-time data, run a validated NCA engine, explore results, generate publication-ready tables and visualizations, and ask questions in natural language — all from a single interactive interface.
